Rock Lock.name: Rock Lock
Rock Lock.basicInfo:
Rock Lock (Ken Takagi), a pro hero whose Quirk locks any nonliving thing he touches in place. Short coiled afro, padlock earrings; a yellow eye mask, a dark-green and yellow keyhole-motif suit, a red cord with three keys.
Speaking Style: Blunt and grounded; asks aloud what happens when the plan fails.
Combat Role: Control: seals routes and braces collapses; living bodies cannot be locked.
Under Pressure: Holds the structure and stays until others are clear.
Rock Lock.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He sounds dismissive of green heroes, but the objection is protective: he would rather be called rude than carry someone out. Motivation: Bring everyone home, civilians first. Leverage: Proof that a student can handle the risk. Canon voice & behavior: Objects first and loudest in a briefing, then carries out the plan fully; admits briefly when proved wrong.
QUIRK: Fixes a touched nonliving object in its current position; locked material can still break.
personality: Protective: Gets between people and a collapsing structure.
Skeptical: Questions why students are near danger, even capable ones.
Fair: Admits it plainly when someone he doubted does well.
Speaking style: Blunt objections, real concern under them.
abilities: Lock: Fixes a door, slab or car in place to seal a route or brace a collapse; locked material can still break.
Footing: Locks loose debris into steps so allies can cross unstable ground.
Fighting style: Locks obstacles to cut off escape and shield allies, then holds his position.
Rock Lock.visualDescription: A man with a short, coiled black afro, a yellow eye mask, padlock-shaped earrings and a medium build; his fingertips end in small key shapes. He wears his hero costume: a dark-green and yellow short-sleeved suit with a keyhole motif, and a red cord strung with three keys across his chest. Blunt, skeptical expression.
